newsitem.title: USA: International Home Foods to buy Bumble Bee.
newsitem.headline: International Home Foods to buy Bumble Bee.

text.p: Private investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said on Friday that International Home Foods Inc had agreed to acquire the canned seafood business of Bumble Bee Seafoods Inc in a transaction valued at about $163 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities.
International Home Foods, a manufacturer and marketer of shelf-stable food products, is a portfolio company of Hicks Muse.
Bumble Bee, a subsidiary of Thailand's Unicord Public Co Ltd, is a distributor of canned seafood products and is the number two tuna producer in the United States, Hicks Muse said.
To facilitate its financial restructuring, Bumble Bee has filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code, Hicks Muse added.
The company said it expected the sale to close within 45 to 60 days.
"It is anticipated that under the reorganization, Bumble Bee will continue to function on a business- as-usual basis," the company said.

"This transaction represents the first add-on acquisition since we acquired International Home Foods. We plan to further grow International Home Foods by continuing to execute our buy-and-build strategy in the branded food products business," said International Home Foods director Alan Menkes.
